A central coaxial shaft and a separate grounded bored rear pedestal complete the apparatus. The new internal-tooth enclosure and common-axis carrier with parallel offset planet axes differ from the old two fixed parallel spur shafts, perpendicular worm/wheel or transverse four-cone differential. All whole numeric geometry is new, not a count change or rearrangement of imported gear meshes. Three opaque constant PBR roles, closed editable components, metres, Z up and whole horizontal bounds-centred bed. One whole model, zero scenes. entries.description: One newly authored complete static ceramics reclaim-basin appearance.
